description: Civil rights do not take freedom away. They expand it. Throughout our history, every advance in civil rights has strengthened this country by making opportunity more real and more equal. When we protect voting rights, defend free speech, and guarantee equal treatment under the law, we are not limiting anyone’s freedom. We are ensuring that freedom belongs to all of us. I believe civil rights are not a threat to democracy. They are the foundation of it.

title: Civil Rights Expand Freedom. They Do Not Take It Away. - Ford for Congress
